title: Application Security Engineer roadmap
summary: A step-by-step guide to become an Application Security Engineer from zero knowledge. It builds foundational security concepts, core engineering skills, a portfolio, and job-ready readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Learn core security concepts and basic communication for developers.

milestones.title: Learn security fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can explain basic confidentiality, integrity, and availability concepts.

tasks.title: Read OWASP Top 10 overview
tasks.description: Study the OWASP Top 10 page on the official site to understand common web risks.

tasks.title: Watch freeCodeCamp security basics video
tasks.description: Complete the 30-minute introductory video on application security.

tasks.title: Summarize key risks in a one-page doc
tasks.description: Write a concise summary of the most critical risks you learned.

tasks.title: Create flashcards for each risk
tasks.description: Use a free tool like Anki to make cards for quick recall.

milestones.title: Secure coding principles
milestones.outcome: Can write code that avoids common vulnerabilities.

tasks.title: Read Secure Coding guidelines on OWASP
tasks.description: Read the official OWASP Secure Coding Practices document.

tasks.title: Complete secure-coding exercises on Codecademy
tasks.description: Finish the 3-exercise module that covers input validation and output encoding.

tasks.title: Refactor a sample script for safety
tasks.description: Take a vulnerable code snippet and apply OWASP guidelines to fix it.

tasks.title: Peer-review your refactor with a friend
tasks.description: Explain the changes you made and get feedback on clarity.

milestones.title: Developer communication basics
milestones.outcome: Can discuss security findings clearly with engineering teams.

tasks.title: Read "Communicating Security" article on SANS
tasks.description: Read the free SANS article on effective security communication.

tasks.title: Write a mock security advisory
tasks.description: Draft a short advisory about a simulated vulnerability for a dev team.

tasks.title: Record a 2-minute explanation video
tasks.description: Explain the advisory verbally and record it to practice tone and clarity.

tasks.title: Share video with a peer for feedback
tasks.description: Get constructive feedback on how understandable your message is.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Develop practical abilities in threat modelling, code review, CI security, and team interaction.

milestones.title: Threat modelling techniques
milestones.outcome: Can create a STRIDE threat model for a simple app.

tasks.title: Read Microsoft threat modeling guide
tasks.description: Study the free Microsoft guide to learn the STRIDE methodology.

tasks.title: Map threats for a sample todo app
tasks.description: Apply STRIDE to a basic todo list application and list threats.

tasks.title: Prioritize threats using risk matrix
tasks.description: Assign likelihood and impact scores to each threat you identified.

tasks.title: Discuss model with a colleague
tasks.description: Explain your threat model and get input on missing items.

milestones.title: Security-focused code review
milestones.outcome: Can perform a code review that identifies security flaws.

tasks.title: Read OWASP code review checklist
tasks.description: Study the official checklist to know what to look for during reviews.

tasks.title: Review a GitHub pull request for XSS
tasks.description: Find a real open-source PR and identify any cross-site scripting issues.

tasks.title: Document findings in review comments
tasks.description: Write clear, actionable comments for each security issue you spot.

tasks.title: Attend a virtual code-review meetup
tasks.description: Join a free community session to observe experienced reviewers.

milestones.title: CI security tooling basics
milestones.outcome: Can integrate static analysis and dependency checks into a CI pipeline.

tasks.title: Watch GitHub Actions security intro on YouTube
tasks.description: Learn the basics of adding security actions to workflows.

tasks.title: Add Dependabot to a sample repo
tasks.description: Enable Dependabot alerts and auto-updates for dependencies.

tasks.title: Configure CodeQL analysis step
tasks.description: Add a CodeQL action to the CI file and run a scan.

tasks.title: Interpret CodeQL report and fix one issue
tasks.description: Read the generated report, locate the issue, and patch the code.

tasks.title: Share pipeline config on a forum for feedback
tasks.description: Post your CI YAML on a security forum and ask for improvements.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate your new security capabilities.

milestones.title: Threat model of an open-source app
milestones.outcome: Portfolio includes a documented STRIDE model with mitigations.

tasks.title: Select a popular open-source repo
tasks.description: Choose a well-known project on GitHub with moderate complexity.

tasks.title: Apply STRIDE and write a report
tasks.description: Create a structured threat-model document using the guide you studied.

tasks.title: Add mitigation recommendations
tasks.description: Propose concrete security controls for each high-risk threat.

tasks.title: Publish the report on GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Host the threat model as a static site for easy sharing.

milestones.title: CI pipeline with security checks
milestones.outcome: Portfolio showcases a CI workflow that runs static analysis and dependency scans.

tasks.title: Fork a sample application repo
tasks.description: Create your own copy of a small web app to modify.

tasks.title: Add Dependabot and CodeQL actions
tasks.description: Integrate both security actions into the GitHub Actions workflow.

tasks.title: Run the pipeline and capture results
tasks.description: Trigger a CI run, then screenshot the security findings.

tasks.title: Write a README explaining the setup
tasks.description: Document how the pipeline works and why each step matters.

tasks.title: Share the repo link in your portfolio
tasks.description: Add the repository URL to your personal portfolio site.

milestones.title: Secure-coding guide for developers
milestones.outcome: Portfolio contains a concise guide that teaches secure coding best practices.

tasks.title: Outline guide sections using OWASP list
tasks.description: Create a skeleton covering input validation, auth, and error handling.

tasks.title: Write examples for each section
tasks.description: Provide code snippets that illustrate good and bad practices.

tasks.title: Design a one-page cheat sheet
tasks.description: Summarize key rules in a printable PDF format.

tasks.title: Gather peer feedback on clarity
tasks.description: Send the guide to a developer friend and ask for improvements.

tasks.title: Publish the guide on your portfolio site
tasks.description: Add the guide as a downloadable resource for visitors.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Advance your expertise and prepare for job or client engagements.

milestones.title: Advanced secure coding patterns
milestones.outcome: Can implement defense-in-depth techniques in production code.

tasks.title: Read "Secure Coding in C++" free e-book chapter
tasks.description: Study the chapter on memory safety and bounds checking.

tasks.title: Implement input sanitization library
tasks.description: Write a reusable module that safely encodes user input for web output.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for security edge cases
tasks.description: Create tests that verify the library blocks malicious payloads.

tasks.title: Benchmark performance impact
tasks.description: Measure latency before and after adding the sanitization layer.

tasks.title: Document trade-offs in a short blog post
tasks.description: Explain why you chose certain patterns over others.

milestones.title: Auth and crypto
milestones.outcome: Can design basic authentication flows and choose appropriate cryptographic primitives.

tasks.title: Study RFC 6749 OAuth 2.0 spec summary on MDN
tasks.description: Read the concise MDN overview of OAuth 2.0 flows.

tasks.title: Implement JWT issuance in a demo app
tasks.description: Write code that creates and verifies JSON Web Tokens securely.

tasks.title: Compare symmetric vs asymmetric encryption
tasks.description: Create a table summarizing use-cases, strengths, and weaknesses.

tasks.title: Run OWASP ZAP scan on the demo app
tasks.description: Use the free ZAP tool to find auth-related vulnerabilities.

tasks.title: Explain findings to a non-technical friend
tasks.description: Practice translating technical results into plain language.

milestones.title: Job and client readiness
milestones.outcome: Can interview confidently and communicate security value to stakeholders.

tasks.title: Read "Tell Me about yourself" guide on The Muse
tasks.description: Study the free article on framing your security background for interviews.

tasks.title: Craft a 5-minute security pitch
tasks.description: Prepare a concise presentation of your portfolio and impact.

tasks.title: Mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Role-play an interview focusing on security scenario questions.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn with security keywords
tasks.description: Add the six key skills to your profile and describe projects.

tasks.title: Join a security community Slack channel
tasks.description: Participate in discussions to expand your network and learn current trends.
